subject: EdgeBridge: processor replacement notice & request for subprocessor declarations
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@edgebridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@edgebridge.io>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Notice: EdgeBridge CDN v1 sunset & processor replacement

Hi Marissa,

Quick heads-up: EdgeBridge will be sunsetting our legacy CDN (v1) in Q1 2027 and routing a subset of processing (log aggregation, edge request telemetry) to a new partner, NimbleTransit. Attached is the vendor transition plan and an initial subprocessor roster for NimbleTransit (nimble-subprocessor-roster-20261105.csv).

We need confirmation from Redwood that the following are acceptable and to collect any evidence you require before we make the switch for Acme Retail:
- Full subprocessor list for NimbleTransit including country of processing and duties
- Any residency/export-control constraints for EU customer traffic
- Required attestations (SOC 2 type II, encryption-in-transit/out-of-rest statements, KMS/HSM usage)
- Timeline constraints — proposal is to start routing non-EU telemetry to NimbleTransit Jan 10, 2027 and EU traffic (if approved) Feb 14, 2027

Please confirm which artifacts you need and your internal owner for the review. If you prefer, Raj at NimbleTransit and our legal team can hop on a short call next week.

Attachments: EBG-v1-to-nimble-transition-plan.pdf, nimble-subprocessor-roster-20261105.csv

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Partnerships Lead | EdgeBridge
lena@edgebridge.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:36:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Notice: EdgeBridge CDN v1 sunset & processor replacement

Forwarding EdgeBridge notice — Acme Retail is impacted based on current routing.

Internal asks: can security/compliance pull a quick gap analysis against our DPA and Acme's residency controls? Specific items I'd like:
- Confirm required evidence set for vendor onboarding (SOC2, penetration test summary, encryption attestations, KMS ownership)
- Determine whether any of NimbleTransit's subprocessors process EU personal data or will cause cross-border transfers that need export controls in the DPA
- Fill the attached subprocessor-inventory-template.csv and mark any high-risk entries
- Proposed internal owner for vendor approval (recommend: Kimberly lead; Naomi to own evidence collection)

Timeline: EdgeBridge wants final sign-off on or before Dec 15, 2026 to keep the Jan rollout. If we need extended review for EU residency, call it out early so they can keep EU traffic on EBG-v1 longer.

Marissa
Sr. Account Lead — Acme Retail | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: EdgeBridge CDN v1 sunset & processor replacement

Thanks for the ping — starting the intake.

Initial checklist I'm requesting from EdgeBridge/NimbleTransit:
- Updated subprocessor roster with country and data-flow role (store, transform, route) — already attached but needs row-level country mapping
- SOC 2 type II report for NimbleTransit and for any listed subprocessor that stores telemetry beyond 30 days
- Confirmation of TLS v1.2+/mTLS usage and whether logs are redacted before export
- KMS details: who controls the keys where logs are encrypted at rest? (NimbleTransit KMS vs customer-managed)
- Data retention defaults and options to restrict export for EU tenants
- Any cross-border transfer mechanisms (STD clauses, SCCs, or adequacy)

Attached: subprocessor-inventory-template.csv — please fill and return to me. I noted two suspicious entries in Nimble's CSV where country is blank.

I'll draft a short DPA amendment checklist for Kimberly to review and will flag anything requiring legal escalation.

-naomi
Lead, Privacy & Compliance | Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: naomi_feldman@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Notice: EdgeBridge CDN v1 sunset & processor replacement

Looping in a couple of operational questions:

1) Fallback plan: If we can't get EU residency assurances by Dec 15, we should define a short-term fallback to keep Acme's EU traffic on EBG-v1 until Feb 28, 2027. Can ops support a split routing for 8 weeks?

2) Cost and latency changes: Need performance delta estimate for telemetry aggregation (per-10k requests). Marissa — can you ask EdgeBridge to produce a quick perf/cost comparison?

3) Encryption and key access: Naomi, if NimbleTransit uses their KMS, we need an access matrix and proof they do not share keys across tenants. If they offer customer-managed keys (CMK) that's preferred for Acme.

4) Attachments: The transition plan lists a "temporary escrow" for EU logs — please validate that against our DPA export-controls.

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@nimbletransit.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@edgebridge.io>, Legal Ops <legal@edgebridge.io>, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Notice: EdgeBridge CDN v1 sunset & processor replacement — nimble follow-up

Hi Marissa / Naomi,

Thanks for the detailed notes and the template. A few quick clarifications from NimbleTransit:
- We've attached an expanded roster (nimble-subprocessor-roster-20261112.csv) that includes country columns and data duties. Two entries previously blank are now marked: LogStoreEU (Germany) and CacheMetrics (US).
- NimbleTransit uses a tenant-isolated KMS backed by AWS KMS. Keys are per-customer by default; customers can elect BYOK via HSM (we referenced this in the transition plan).
- SOC 2 type II is available for NimbleTransit and we can provide redacted reports for select subprocessors under NDA — we'll upload to your secure drive link.
- For EU traffic: we propose a phased approach — Non-EU cutover Jan 10; EU hold until we obtain explicit residency approval. If you need extended hold, we can push EU cutover to Mar 1, 2027.

Attachments: nimble-subprocessor-roster-20261112.csv, nimble-kms-architecture.pdf

Let us know what additional evidence you'd like and we'll prioritize. We're happy to do a short call next week to walk through the roster.

Best,
Raj Patel
Head of Integrations | NimbleTransit
raj.patel@nimbletransit.com
